fat_count_mismatch.name: FAT count mismatch
fat_count_mismatch.message: CFB header declares {declared} FAT sectors; DIFAT lists {actual}.
fat_count_mismatch.continuation_message: DIFAT chain continues past its declared length.
fat_count_mismatch.unreadable_message: DIFAT could not be fully read: {reason}. CFB header declares {declared} FAT sectors; at least {actual} FAT sector IDs were read.

unknown_exporter.name: Unknown exporter
unknown_exporter.message: AAF exporter is {product} ({company}); these rules are tuned for Adobe Premiere Pro.

format_mismatch.name: Format mismatch
format_mismatch.fix_instruction: Re-export audio in the expected format with matching AAF descriptors.

embedded_audio_unreadable.name: Embedded audio unreadable
embedded_audio_unreadable.message: Embedded audio cannot be read in full.

offline_clip.name: Offline clip
offline_clip.message: Clip has no embedded essence or linked media file that exists.
offline_clip.fix_instruction: Include the missing media in the delivery folder and re-export the AAF.

media_outside_delivery_folder.name: Media outside delivery folder
media_outside_delivery_folder.message: Linked media exists only outside the delivery folder.
media_outside_delivery_folder.fix_instruction: Include the media in the delivery folder and re-export the AAF.

digital_silence.name: Digital silence
digital_silence.message: Every sample in the used range plus handles is digital zero.
digital_silence.fix_instruction: Check the source audio in the edit and re-export with audible media.

short_handles.name: Short handles
short_handles.message: Short delivered handles ({handles}); need at least {threshold} sequence frames on each side.

low_level.name: Low level
low_level.message: Peak {peak_dbfs:.2f} dBFS over the used range plus handles is at or below {floor_dbfs:g} dBFS.
